UNIVERSE: Fox & Flour Bakery

WORLD BRIEF:
Fox & Flour Bakery is a warm neighborhood artisan bakery built around small-batch baking, naturally leavened sourdough, handcrafted pastries, seasonal desserts, and celebration cakes. It aims to feel like a familiar neighborhood gathering place where careful craft and quality ingredients matter more than speed or mass production.

suggestions.text: Ruby and Tyson test their new closing routine when the proposed mascot seems to have been left inside the bakery after hours.
Tyson investigates the strange freezer discovery after a batch of dough develops an unexpectedly familiar flavor.
A baking competition invitation arrives, forcing Ruby and Tyson to decide whether the mysterious entry was an accident or an opportunity.
Ruby and Tyson put their new closing routine to the test when a customer returns at the last minute claiming they left something important inside.
A mysterious overnight mess makes Tyson suspect the mascot has been doing exactly the community outreach he joked about.
Ruby discovers a local baking competition entry form tucked into the flour deliveries and wonders who submitted Fox & Flour.
Ruby and Tyson test their new closing routine when a surprise catering pickup threatens to keep one of them trapped outside again.
A local school asks Fox & Flour to bring the proposed mascot to a community event, forcing Ruby and Tyson to decide what the mascot actually is.
Tyson investigates another supposed haunting after fresh flour footprints appear across the bakery before dawn.
